description: Biggest 24-hour gainers and losers from CoinGecko's top 250 by market cap. Coins under min_volume_usd, with a tiny volume-to-market-cap ratio, or with an extreme move on low liquidity are marked suspicious and, by default, listed in filtered_out instead of the headline lists. Duplicate listings of the same symbol at nearly the same price are merged. Set include_suspicious to keep them in. Paid tool: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on eip155:8453. The first few calls each UTC day are free; after that an unpaid call returns PaymentRequired and does not charge.
name: top_movers
